title: Set up app key vaults for Business Central online

facts.text: App key vaults only supported with Marketplace apps on Business Central online, not with per-tenant extensions or dev extensions.
Extensions can use up to two key vaults for storing secrets needed in Azure.
Create Azure key vault and add secrets through Azure portal, Azure CLI, or other methods.
Provision Dynamics 365 Business Central ISV key vault Reader application in Microsoft Entra tenant using Microsoft Graph PowerShell SDK modules.
Grant key vault reader application permission to read secrets using Access policies or Azure Role-Based Access Control.
Create AllowedBusinessCentralAppIds secret in key vault containing app IDs separated by comma or semicolon.
Key vault URLs in app.json must belong to same Microsoft Entra tenant as the key vault itself.
Link between Marketplace app and key vault registered on submission and cannot be removed as breaking change; access cannot be deregistered once established.
